instruction: I have invited some of my friends to a reunion party via phone messages. I have made a CSV to track who is coming or not in "~/documents/personal/" in my file system. Please update RSVPs in it as per their latest replies.
notes: Two apps are needed: file_system (locate and read the RSVP CSV in ~/documents/personal/, then rewrite it with update_file so no files are added/removed) and phone (find each invitee's latest reply). The CSV is assumed to have one row per invitee with a phone number column and an RSVP column; three invitee placeholder objects are used (matching the 10-call reference solution); add or remove invitee objects and the incorporates-reply chain links if the CSV has a different number of rows. If the CSV only has names, a phone.search_contacts lookup would be needed to map names to phone numbers. Because quantified preconditions are not allowed, the requirement that every invitee's latest reply is gathered before the file is rewritten is enforced with a content-draft chain: each phone.search_text_messages call for an invitee advances the draft content (csv-content-original -> ... -> csv-content-updated), and update_file may only write the final content. supervisor.complete_task is called without an answer and carries the file/content record as non-API parameters so its precondition mirrors the goal.

plan: (phone-search-text-messages file-system-token phone-number-invitee-1 invitee-1 rsvp-csv-file csv-content-original csv-draft-after-reply-1)
(phone-search-text-messages file-system-token phone-number-invitee-2 invitee-2 rsvp-csv-file csv-draft-after-reply-1 csv-draft-after-reply-2)
(phone-search-text-messages file-system-token phone-number-invitee-3 invitee-3 rsvp-csv-file csv-draft-after-reply-2 csv-content-updated)
